Five parts: participants and transaction (identity, The Proposed Investment); economics (Option Pool and Anti-Dilution, Liquidation Preference); governance and founder terms; process and closing (Conditions and Completion, Expiry); legal status (Status of this Term Sheet, Exclusivity, Confidentiality and Costs, governing law, signatures).

Version 1.0 borrowed five shareholders'-agreement clauses (CORP_ANTI_DILUTION_001, CORP_BOARD_INVESTOR_CONTROL_001, CORP_SHARE_TRANSFER_001, CORP_TAG_ALONG_001, CORP_DRAG_ALONG_001) drafted as operative obligations. Its output is frozen in tests/fixtures/termSheet.D4_44.defective.json.
mandatory_legal_checks: Contract Act 1872 S.10 — whether a term sheet binds is decided on its terms; the binding/non-binding split must be explicit and consistent
Companies Act 2013 S.62(1)(c) — a preferential issue needs a special resolution and a price determined by a registered valuer's report, subject to S.42
Companies Act 2013 S.71(1) — debentures with an option to convert need a special resolution

Income-tax Act S.56(2)(viib) (angel tax) was omitted by the Finance (No. 2) Act, 2024; the Income-tax Act, 2025 has replaced the 1961 Act from 1 April 2026 — the current position for share premium and for shares received below fair value needs advocate review before it is cited
IBC 2016 S.53 — a liquidation preference ranks only among shareholders and cannot displace creditors
FEMA (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019 — pricing and reporting where the investor is resident outside India
